name: better-person
statement: I want to learn to be a better person

nodes.name: Name what 'better' means to you, in your own tradition and words
misconceptions: adopts the tutor's values instead of stating their own

nodes.name: Understand one framework you chose (its claims and practices)
misconceptions: summarises the framework as generic self-help

nodes.name: Keep a small daily practice and reflect on it weekly
misconceptions: treats a missed day as a failure of character

families.stem: In two or three sentences: what would being 'better' look like in an ordinary week for you?
In your chosen text, what does it say about {topic}? Quote the line you are relying on.
families.key: accurate to the learner's chosen source

families.stem: Explain {practice} from your chosen text to a friend who has never read it, in your own words.
Did you do today's practice? Anything you noticed?
Looking back at this week's log, what pattern do you see, and what would you change?
